selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the traveler want to do next to grow stronger in faith?
questions.answer: He wants to look at the whole universe and learn from it.

questions.question: What tool does he use to look at the universe in a deeper way?
questions.answer: He uses a wide, special way of seeing learned from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What are two things the universe is compared to?
questions.answer: A book and a palace.

questions.question: How does the universe show meaning and order?
questions.answer: Its parts change in a wise and organized way.

questions.question: What do these ordered changes show about the One who made everything?
questions.answer: That He knows everything and has power over everything.

questions.question: Who is described as writing the book of the universe?
questions.answer: A glorious Creator who sees all things and knows how they fit together.

questions.question: Which parts of the universe give this message?
questions.answer: Its kinds, tiny pieces, living things, and all that comes in and goes out.

questions.question: What do all these parts say together about the Maker?
questions.answer: That there is one great Maker.

questions.question: What qualities of the Maker are mentioned?
questions.answer: Greatness, no equal, endless power, and perfect wisdom.

questions.question: Why is the witness of the cosmos called very great?
questions.answer: Because it is as vast as the whole universe.

questions.question: Why does the traveler turn to the whole cosmos?
questions.answer: To reach another level of faith.

questions.question: What does he hope will happen to the lessons he already learned?
questions.answer: They will become more complete and full of light.

questions.question: When he looks carefully, what does the cosmos seem like?
questions.answer: It seems like a living book, a beautiful palace, and an orderly city.

questions.question: What does this tell us about the cosmos: messy or well-planned?
questions.answer: It is well-planned.

questions.question: What do even the smallest parts of this great “book” help show?
questions.answer: They help show that there is a Creator.

questions.question: What do the ongoing changes in the world point to?
questions.answer: They point to a Knower and Powerful Maker.

questions.question: How well does this Maker know things?
questions.answer: He knows all things and how they connect.

questions.question: Do only big things in the universe give this message, or big and small things together?
questions.answer: Big and small things together.

questions.question: What do the creatures and particles say in one voice?
questions.answer: That there is one Maker and one Lord.

questions.question: What do the wise renewals in the world show about the Maker’s way of working?
questions.answer: He works with power and wisdom.

questions.question: What is the main goal of the traveler in this passage?
questions.answer: To increase his faith.

questions.question: Where does he go for a new lesson after learning from parts of creation?
questions.answer: He goes to the whole universe.

questions.question: What does the universe look like to him because it is full of meaning and order?
questions.answer: Like a written book and a carefully made home.

questions.question: What kinds of changes happen in the universe that still show order?
questions.answer: Changes that keep happening in a meaningful and wise way.
